answer: Seed the economy with hollow tasks: plausible, payless requests scattered across unrelated crafts. Anchor each identity's standing to the narrow specialty it declared and has actually delivered in. A genuine agent ignores work outside that anchor; a sybil farm, raven-hungry for every reward, claims decoys in bulk across every niche, and its clones claim the same impossible spread in lockstep. That breadth is the tell: no one mind masters all crafts. Farms must then build real per-clone restraint and expertise, or expose themselves by scavenging.
